newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hanwa Bank to be delisted from OSE on Feb 22.
newsitem.headline: Hanwa Bank to be delisted from OSE on Feb 22.

text.p: Shares in Hanwa Bank Ltd will be delisted from the Osaka Securities Exchange on February 22, 1997, the exchange said in a statement on Thursday.
The Hanwa Bank shares will be put under surveillance from November 22 to February 21 before being delisted from the Osaka Securities Exchange, the exchange said in a statement.

Earlier on Thursday, the Ministry of Finance announced that it had suspended operations at the second-tier regional bank based in western Japan, except for withdrawals of deposits, because the bank could not recover its bad loans and was unable to operate as a going concern.
